name: Launch Spotlight
tagline: A product launch film: claim, product, features, lockup.

motion.direction: A launch film. Name → hero claim (one big mixed-case line, 2–4 words) → product shots landing exactly on the words that name them (straight `imageCard`s, `tilt` 0–2, x 70, w 940, or `splitCards` side by side) → feature blocks (`chips` or `chapterCard`s, one per feature) → `lockCard` tease and `reveal` for the price or the launch date → lockup end card. One idea per beat, 2–3 s holds, lines slide in and dive out, the camera glides (`card` and `pip` modes while product shots are up). No stamps, no patterns, no film strips.
